children.value: > Fact From Story: Beyoncé's concert picture, “Renaissance: A Film by Beyoncé,” opened in first place with $21 million in North American ticket sales
> > Fact From Story: Not accounting for inflation, it’s the first time a film has opened over $20 million on this weekend in 20 years (since “The Last Samurai”). | Fact From Story
> > > Fact From Story: The post-Thanksgiving, early December box office is notoriously slow, but “Renaissance” defied the odds.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Defying the odds and breaking records indicates a successful performance.
> > Fact From Story: The post-Thanksgiving, early December box office is notoriously slow, but “Renaissance” defied the odds. | Fact From Story
> > > Fact From Story: Beyoncé wrote, directed and produced “Renaissance,” which is focused on the tour for her Grammy-winning album.
> > > Fact From Story: It debuted in 2,539 theaters in the U.S. and Canada, as well as 94 international territories, where it earned $6.4 million from 2,621 theaters.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: The person who directs and produces a film has more control over the film's success than someone who does not.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Defying the odds and breaking records indicates a successful performance. | Commonsense Knowledge
> Commonsense Knowledge: Earning the first place position and earning $21 million in ticket sales indicates a successful opening for a film.
